key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて、壊すことも動かすこともできなさそうだ……

key: The rock base may hold more valuables.
en: The rock base may hold more valuables.
ja: この岩の土台には、まだお宝が隠されているかもしれない。

key: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
ja: ばくはつのこなを使って開けますか?

key: That dragon lady causes far too many problems... and now you, too!
en: That dragon lady causes far too many problems... and now you, too!
ja: あのドラゴン女は　やっかい事ばかり　起こしやがる……そのうえ　おまえまでか!

key: This world is full of problems though.
en: This world is full of problems though.
ja: まあ　この世界は　やっかい事だらけだがな

key: I suppose I'm luckier to have fewer problems than some.
en: I suppose I'm luckier to have fewer problems than some.
ja: オレなんかは　まだ　やっかい事が　少ないだけ　マシなんだろうさ

key: We won't let you foil our plans this time!
en: We won't let you foil our plans this time!
ja: 今度こそ　計画の　じゃまは　させないぞ!

key: That is... Well, someone else will have to stop you.
en: That is... Well, someone else will have to stop you.
ja: というか……まあ　止めるのは　誰か別のやつに　まかせるとするか

key: Uh... please don't foil our plans this time?
en: Uh... please don't foil our plans this time?
ja: えっと……今回は　計画の　じゃまを　しないで　くれないか?
